response: {"__model_dump_json__": "{\"statements\":[\"Meridian's policy for a lost employee badge is as follows.\",\"Report the lost badge immediately to Facilities as soon as the badge is noticed missing.\",\"Facilities issues a temporary access badge on the same day the loss is reported.\",\"The temporary badge can be used right away.\",\"The original badge is deactivated within one hour after the loss is reported.\",\"Deactivating the original badge prevents unauthorized access.\",\"Details include who to contact in Facilities and how to request a permanent replacement.\",\"The badge-access.md document contains further details.\",\"The Facilities team provides further details.\"]}"}
